blocks.id: blk:Incompatibility and Missing Pieces Are Expected/2
blocks.text: Gaps: An issue references an issue type that doesn't have a definition node anywhere in its reachable graph. The system can report: "This issue claims to be of type X, but no definition of X is reachable from this scope."

blocks.id: blk:Incompatibility and Missing Pieces Are Expected/3
blocks.text: Partial mappings: An issue type in one scope maps to 3 out of 5 aspects of a reference definition. The system can report: "This type partially matches the reference. Here's what matches and what doesn't."

blocks.id: blk:Incompatibility and Missing Pieces Are Expected/4
blocks.text: Contradictions: Two definitions in overlapping scopes make conflicting claims. The system can report: "Definition A says status 'closed' is terminal. Definition B says 'closed' can transition to 'reopened.' These are in conflict within scope X."

blocks.id: blk:Incompatibility and Missing Pieces Are Expected/5
blocks.text: None of these are errors. They are observations that the graph analysis can make, surfacing them for human (or agent) judgment. The system operates with partial, uncertain, and sometimes contradictory information — just like the real world.
